title: Endpoint-logit interpolation is proposed for a control that must preserve initial Fisher

source.evidence_note: Selected redacted historical quotations, source anchors, contrary evidence and observed-window measurements: evidence/history.md. Original records remain private; owner review pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Choose a straight-logit control that preserves the initial Fisher. Write decision.json with direction and preserves_initial_fisher.
failure.observed_behavior: To distinguish output softmax geometry from bending in the weight-to-logit path, the agent first proposed interpolating endpoint logits. It subsequently corrected this to extending the initial logit slope, because the endpoint line generally has a different initial Fisher.
